items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Benny Goodman before he became famous was one whom Benny knew and introduced to the band.

ctx.x: The band was wonderful without a doubt and quite a few white musicians from down town came to hear us at different times. Benny Goodman before he became famous was one whom Benny knew and introduced to the band. The show was good and had some beautiful girls. Charlie Barnet was another down town bandleader who came to the Club quite often. It was after I knew him at the Strand Ballroom that he formed a band which played in a big hotel down town.
